description: This script configures and launches PyTorch inference on Intel Xeon Scalable Processors, supporting single and multi-instance modes with thread and memory optimizations, including NUMA binding, thread affinity, and memory allocators like tcmalloc and jemalloc.

classes.name: _CPUinfo
classes.description: Class for retrieving CPU core and NUMA node information on Linux systems.

classes.name: _Launcher
classes.description: Class responsible for setting environment variables, thread affinity, memory allocators, and launching processes for inference.

methods.name: add_lib_preload
methods.description: Enables preload of specific libraries (tcmalloc, jemalloc, iomp5) for performance optimization.

methods.name: is_numactl_available
methods.description: Checks if numactl is available on the system.

methods.name: set_memory_allocator
methods.description: Configures the memory allocator (tcmalloc or jemalloc) via LD_PRELOAD.

methods.name: set_env
methods.description: Sets environment variables with optional warnings and logs.

methods.name: set_multi_thread_and_allocator
methods.description: Configures multi-threading environment, including thread affinity and memory allocators.

methods.name: launch
methods.description: Prepares core binding, environment, and launches the inference process with proper configuration.

methods.name: create_args
methods.description: Defines command-line argument parser for configuring multi-instance, core binding, and environment options.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main entry point that parses arguments, verifies environment, and initiates process launch.
